institution: University of Arkansas at Little Rock

app_fee.value: Non-refundable $40 application fee required before processing (exempt for McNair Scholars, military members, and Indus Foundation applicants per catalog and Policy LR 509.3).
app_fee.quote: All applicants must pay a non-refundable $40 application fee before their application can be processed.

also.quote: A non-refundable application fee of $40.00 is required of all applicants except for McNair Scholars and military members.
A non-refundable application fee is required for all applicants, except for McNair Scholars and applicants who apply through the Indus Foundation.

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers are available only in rare extenuating circumstances on request, for McNair Scholars, military members, Indus Foundation applicants, or previously admitted students reapplying to defer.
fee_waiver.quote: In rare circumstances, an application fee waiver may be requested.

also.quote: A non-refundable application fee of $40.00 is required of all applicants except for McNair Scholars and military members. | In these cases, the graduate application fee will be waived for students who need to reapply.
A non-refundable application fee is required for all applicants, except for McNair Scholars and applicants who apply through the Indus Foundation.

gre_general.value: Set by individual graduate programs rather than the Graduate School; all 8 STEM Ph.D. programs at UA Little Rock require GRE General scores (with program-specific GPA or institutional waivers; scores must be within 5 years). See each program record.

toefl_min.value: Doctoral applicants need at least 79 TOEFL iBT (550 PBT, 213 CBT); scores must be within 2 years. Note: the 'Minimum score of 4 on TOEFL iBT' on the International English Requirements page appears under Undergraduate Students; graduate doctoral admission still uses 79 iBT. Individual programs (e.g., CIS) may expect higher than 79.
toefl_min.quote: Doctoral applicants must achieve a score of 550 on the paper-based test, 213 on the computer-based version, or 79 on the Internet-based version.

also.quote: *TOEFL or IELTS scores must be from tests taken within the past 2 years.

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic overall score is 6.5 (scores must be from tests taken within the past 2 years).
ielts_min.quote: On the IELTS, all applicants must make at least a 6.5.

also.quote: *TOEFL or IELTS scores must be from tests taken within the past 2 years.

english_waiver.value: An English-medium degree from India does not waive TOEFL/IELTS. Policy LR 509.9 (revised April 2026) and the Graduate Catalog exempt only applicants who studied full-time for 2+ years at an English-instruction institution located in a country where English is the native language (Canada except Quebec, Ireland, UK, Australia, New Zealand, or Commonwealth Caribbean) or hold a U.S. bachelor's degree.
english_waiver.quote: Only students who have studied full-time for two or more years at a college or university where English is the language of instruction located in a country where English is the native language are exempt from the TOEFL, the IELTS, or the PTE.

also.quote: Native English speakers with citizenship of an exempt country: Canada (except Quebec), Ireland, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, or the Commonwealth Caribbean.

notes: All 10 Ph.D. programs in the 2026-2027 Graduate Catalog were reviewed; 2 are non-STEM (Criminal Justice Ph.D., Reading Ph.D.) and 8 STEM Ph.D. tracks are included across 12 fields. International transcripts from non-IAU-recognized institutions or for transfer credit require a NACES articulation (Policy LR 509.9 also states outside articulation for international academic records). Doctoral GA minimum 9-month stipend was increased from $13,000 to $15,000 starting Fall 2026, plus 9 credit hours tuition waiver and up to $400/semester health insurance reimbursement.
